media.caption: A brief declaration with two signatures. Its text announces independence and addresses the transfer of power. This typed version and the handwritten ANRI draft are different forms of the same proclamation.
notice: Find the signatures and the dated line.
Distinguish the proclamation’s words from evidence of control over territory.
This small facsimile has limited resolution; use the evidence paraphrase and archival reference for reading.
media.creator: Proclamation signed by Sukarno and Mohammad Hatta; digital facsimile via Wikimedia Commons
media.material: Typed text and signatures, reproduced as a digital image
media.relevance: An actual proclamation makes the difference between a political declaration and subsequent implementation visible.
